newsitem.title: USA: AEP Cook 2 power plant trips off line.
newsitem.headline: AEP Cook 2 power plant trips off line.

text.p: American Electric Power Co's 1,090 megawatt (MW) Cook 2 nuclear power plant tripped off line Tuesday after a feed regulator valve controller failed, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday.
The unit is being kept in hot standby and tentatively set to restart on Friday, the NRC said in its daily status report.
An American Electric Power spokesman said technicians had not yet determined how long the plant would be off line for repairs, but said the outage was not expected to last more than four days.
"They haven't really narrowed it down yet, but it probably will not be much longer than three or four days," said spokesman Bill Schalk.
The unit is located in Bridgman, Mich.
The adjoining 1,020 megawatt Cook nuclear power unit 1 has been shut since Feb 28 for scheduled maintenance and refueling and was expected to return to service near April 14.
